author: Russell Brand
description:
Andrew Kern argues that our education system succeeds at one thing above all else—not producing knowledgeable students, but producing anxious people. From childhood to adulthood, he suggests fear has become the hidden curriculum, raising profound questions about attention, learning, parenting, and what it really means to educate a child.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Tucker Carlson has announced he will not support the Republican Party and will not support the Democratic Party, calling out a political system he says is simply not loyal to the United States. Russell Brand argues this is not just a personal departure but a deliberate and significant move to usher in a new populism, one that recognizes both parties as expressions of the same broken corporatist system that paints itself as compassionate every four years while delivering the same ineptitude regardless of who wins. The best you can hope for under the current arrangement, Russell says, is the satisfaction of watching your opponents fail.
